sections.label: Intro · 薄荷街角
sections.note: long straight past the red bike + bench (A), short switchbacks

sections.label: Verse 1 · 石砖小巷
sections.note: cobble zigzag corridor through cut-away courtyard walls, staircase, switchbacks along the teal wall

sections.label: Verse 1 end · 绿庭院螺旋
sections.note: square spiral up round the green courtyard (B) to +3

sections.label: Chorus 1 · 公园遮阳伞
sections.note: +3 deck: staircases cross OVER the verse alleys (Bridge A); parasols open on the kick

sections.label: Break · 下沉喷泉广场
sections.note: drop to L0, sweeping S under the chorus deck

sections.label: Verse 2 · 市场拱廊
sections.note: +6 terrace: switchbacks under coral awnings, wrap through the market arcade (D); E1 bunny tile under the bench

sections.label: Break 2 · 观景台
sections.note: viewpoint straight: the whole town below

sections.label: Final chorus · 五人广场
sections.note: jump onto Bridge B over the five-dancer plaza (C)

sections.label: Final chorus b · 像素浮雕墙
sections.note: spiral round the teal stepped wall with the five-colour pixel relief (E) to +6

sections.label: Final chorus c · 巴士街
sections.note: big drop to the bus street; switchbacks to the finish

objects.name: A 红色自行车与长椅
B 绿色庭院 (the V1 spiral winds round it)
D 市场拱廊 (coral awnings, columns, flags)
E1 长椅下的白色像素兔砖 (flips once in the final chorus to show five colour squares)
C 五人广场: five abstract dancer sculptures (no faces)
E 青绿阶梯墙与五色像素浮雕
E2 自行车铃 (silent wobble on taps)
